limitations: The SQL adapter creates an index per file partition; persistent corpus reuse is not implemented.
Repository scope matching retains its existing glob semantics. SQL path filters are available to the index query.
SQL candidate compilation broadens oversized plans and sibling predicates; the matcher confirms candidates.
The projected JSON row queue is unchanged.
No full-repository performance claim is made. Matched controls use a shared host.
comparisonInterpretation: Historical measurements of an adapter that rebuilt the SQL index per file partition. They are not a valid comparison of equivalent index lifetimes.
